resources.string: Connect to a competition server or use the timer offline on this device.
Enter an HTTP/HTTPS server address without a path, credentials or query, e.g. 192.168.1.10:8008

The screen stays on while the timer is open. Do not lock the device or switch apps: background sound is not supported. After connecting, tap the timer to enable sound; enable this screen’s audio in the primary browser. Keep the device connected to power during a competition.
Return to connection settings? Sound on this device will stop. The server timer will continue. A standalone run will leave its current page.
Check the address, Wi-Fi, server and port. Retry or choose another server. The app will not start a standalone timer automatically.
HTTPS certificate validation failed. Use a server with a certificate trusted by this device. Certificate errors are not bypassed; for a trusted local network you can explicitly enter an HTTP address.
